hints.title: Sort for Pair Convergence
hints.text: Sorting the array allows pairing elements from opposite ends.

hints.title: Opposite Pointers Check
hints.text: Place pointers at the start and end of the sorted array.

hints.title: Adjust Pointers by Sum
hints.text: If sum equals k, increment operations and move both pointers inward. If sum is less than k advance left, else advance right.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Quadratic brute force pairing search is too slow for n = 10^5.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorting enables two-pointer convergence in O(n log n) time and O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate implements standard two-pointer sum matching or hash map frequency counting.
